utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still happening, and I’m keeping an eye on the details. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm the time and place once you have them?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I just don’t have the repair drive details in front of me right now. If you want, I can help you piece them together from what we know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works—let’s piece it together from what we know, and I’ll double-check the details as we go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and warm for everyone. Let’s make sure we’ve got the list, the tools, and the volunteers lined up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I can help line up tools and volunteers. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Dane. We still need the tool list checked, a few more volunteers confirmed, and the sign-in table set up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a repair drive is happening—what kind of help do they need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly tools, a few hands, and anyone who can fix a loose hinge or patch a fence. I’ve got a spare drill if they need one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds useful—I can pass that along if I hear more. Do you know where they’re collecting things?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Could you help spread the word and bring any tools or spare parts people can lend?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll spread the word and ask folks to bring any tools or spare parts they can lend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll pass the word around about the repair drive and keep folks posted. Let’s make sure everyone knows when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a big help. I’ll make sure the time and place are clear too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep everyone updated as details come in. Just send me the time and place, and I’ll repeat it around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive today—want me to add you to the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please add me. Just let me know the date and time, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the date and time as soon as I have it, and I’ll put you on the invite list now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I can ask around and pass it along if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — that’d be a big help. I keep losing track of who’s bringing what, so if you hear anything, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll ask around and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Faye — I’m a bit worried about timing since the school pickup window is tight. If we can keep it after 3:30, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works — I’ll aim for after 3:30 and keep it clear of pickup time. Let me know if there’s anything else I should factor in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — appreciate it. I’ll let you know if I hear anything on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll do the same and let you know if I hear anything out and about.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered, but what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A cordless drill and any spare screws would help a lot. If you’ve got some time, you could also bring a box for sorting the small parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—I’ll bring a cordless drill, some spare screws, and a box for the small parts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Cleo — are you still collecting items for the repair drive, or has everything already been sorted?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still collecting a few things — it’s not fully sorted yet. If you’ve got anything to spare, I can add it to the pile.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ve got a few usable things. What do you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to make sure the timing and supplies are sorted first. Do you know what’s needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet—I just heard it needs a few basic tools and some extra hands. I can ask around and get you a clearer list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot—if you can get the list, I can check what I already have and what I’d need to bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, still on for today — I’ve got my tools ready if folks need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, I just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just let me know the plan and I’ll keep to it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send the plan and the pickup spots, and I’ll keep it all organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Opal. Once you send it over, I’ll follow the plan and be at the pickup spots on time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive — I’ll stop by and bring a few tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great, Vik — thank you! I’ll let the others know you’re coming by with tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll swing by after lunch and see what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Rosa — I’m telling everyone about the repair drive, and I’d love for you to join us. Are you free this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Quinn — yes, I’m free this Saturday and happy to help with the repair drive. Just let me know where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Rosa — thank you! Meet us at the community center at 9 a.m., and I’ll put you with the setup crew.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not much yet — we’re just getting organized. We can still use your help if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’m in. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things simple today. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — could you handle sign-in at the repair drive and help direct people where to go? That would keep things simple and really help us out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can do sign-in and point people the right way. Just keep it clear and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo—could you help collect a few tools and maybe spread the word around the block?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can grab a few tools and let folks know on the block.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list ready for the repair drive—just tell me what still needs picking up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, send me the list and I’ll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll send it over right now. Thanks, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and point people to the sign-up details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send people to the sign-up details. If you want, I can also help phrase a quick message for different groups.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. I could use help sorting donations and maybe carrying a few boxes over to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. I’ll help sort the donations and carry boxes over to the hall.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you first confirm which items are still needed and where they should be dropped off? I want to make sure we get the details right before I ask anyone to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m a bit fuzzy on the list, but I can check what’s still needed and where to drop it off. Give me a minute and I’ll get back to you.
